extracted.subtask_description: Reporting and publishing news articles about wartime military, political, and social events for newspaper readership, often using wire-service copy and pooled dispatches under communications constraints.

rubrics_metrics.name: Qualities of effective wartime reporting
rubrics_metrics.description: Reporting should provide a fast, accurate, comprehensive and colorful picture of events.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Despite space and communications limitations, the elaborate arrangements among wire services and pooled reporting aimed to deliver coverage that was timely (fast), factually correct (accurate), wide-ranging (comprehensive) and vivid (colorful).

rubrics_metrics.name: Pooling and sharing of dispatches under communications limits
rubrics_metrics.description: When communications were limited, accounts from different reporters were pooled and made available to all represented organizations in major hubs (e.g., London and New York).
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Pool reporters' work and distribute shared dispatches so that multiple outlets can run a coherent, consolidated account; this practice helps maintain coverage continuity and quality when individual communications channels are constrained.
